identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, independent authority, or memory continuity.
x1_freeze_rule: No v643-v2 x2 implementation or observed outcome may enter the dedicated x1 commit.

proposals.title: Radiative-stability counterterm closure and technical-naturalness promotion barrier
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT scalar-tensor/EFT operator inventory, symmetry assumptions, loop-generated counterterms, cutoff hierarchy, coefficient scaling, and technical-naturalness claim limits
proposals.hypothesis: A typed synthetic counterterm-closure tribunal can detect when a proposed GMUT operator set is not closed under its declared symmetry and power-counting assumptions without treating the tribunal as a quantum calculation or UV completion.
proposals.null_or_failure: An undeclared loop-generated operator is omitted, symmetry-breaking suppression is asserted without an assumption, cutoff scaling is inconsistent, or local closure is promoted to radiative stability, empirical confirmation, proof, canon, or UV completion.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate symmetry, loop order, cutoff exponent, generated operator, coefficient hierarchy, and promotion fields; every unsupported closure or protected claim must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last typed operator basis, retain the failed counterterm, narrow the claim to a structural fixture, and require an actual quantum calculation plus expert review for further promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases tested stability, kinetic rank, positivity, operator-basis redundancy, and EFT truncation; none tested counterterm closure under declared symmetry and technical-naturalness assumptions.

proposals.title: Jordan-Einstein frame observable dictionary and matter-coupling equivalence tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT frame transformations, unit scaling, matter coupling, redshift, distance, clock, mass, and dimensionless observable mappings
proposals.hypothesis: A dimensionless observable dictionary can require frame transformations to carry units and matter couplings consistently and reject apparent disagreements caused by comparing non-equivalent observables.
proposals.null_or_failure: A conformal transformation changes a dimensionless observable, matter coupling is silently dropped, clocks or masses remain unscaled, an inverse map is absent, or a dictionary pass is called empirical equivalence for all scalar-tensor theories.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate conformal factors, dimension assignments, redshift maps, matter couplings, inverse maps, and equivalence claims; inconsistent dictionaries must be rejected.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the mismatched observable, restore the last invertible typed map, and require model-specific derivation and empirical comparison before any physical-equivalence claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Field-redefinition and gauge-orbit work did not build a Jordan-Einstein observable-and-unit dictionary with explicit matter-coupling preservation.

proposals.title: Renormalization-scale running and Wilson-coefficient uncertainty ledger for GMUT
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT EFT renormalization scales, beta-function placeholders, coefficient covariance, matching scale, truncation, and real-data promotion locks
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic scale-running ledger can preserve matching-scale and coefficient-covariance obligations and expose scale-sensitive claims without pretending to compute GMUT beta functions or likelihoods.
proposals.null_or_failure: A coefficient is treated as scale independent without an assumption, covariance is erased, a matching scale is absent, synthetic beta fixtures are called calculations, or zero-row structure is promoted to a prediction or force.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate scale order, matching scale, beta sign, coefficient covariance, truncation, real-row count, and promotion fields; unsupported running must stay synthetic.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last declared scale ledger, retain the counterexample, and require model-specific loop calculations, real measurements, likelihood execution, uncertainty analysis, and independent review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Cutoff and truncation ledgers did not model renormalization-scale order, matching-scale provenance, beta placeholders, or Wilson-coefficient covariance.

proposals.title: Expectation, blinding-integrity, and measurement-reactivity gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS participant and assessor expectations, blinding success, measurement reactivity, guess capture, protocol deviations, and matched-budget estimands
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered synthetic protocol can separate assignment concealment from measured blinding integrity and flag expectancy or measurement-reactivity pathways before outcome analysis.
proposals.null_or_failure: Blinding is inferred from procedure alone, treatment guesses are collected after outcomes, measurement itself changes exposure without accounting, assessor and participant roles are conflated, or a synthetic pass is called THOS superiority.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate guess timing, role separation, measurement schedule, deviation handling, budget parity, and superiority claims; every compromised protocol must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic protocol, retain the compromised vector, and preregister a replacement before any authorized blind matched-budget real-arm study.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier THOS phases tested allocation, missingness, rater drift, instrument drift, and protocol deviations; none separated expectancy assessment from measurement-reactivity pathways.

proposals.title: Recovery-contact quorum, coercion, and post-recovery notification state machine for Freed ID
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID recovery contacts, quorum diversity, contact replacement, coercion flags, replay prevention, notification, authenticator invalidation, and production assurance boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic recovery state machine can fail closed on single-contact capture, repeated contact channels, stale quorums, coercion indicators, replayed recovery material, or missing post-recovery notification.
proposals.null_or_failure: One contact silently controls recovery, nominally distinct contacts share a channel, used codes remain valid, notifications are omitted, coercion is ignored, or synthetic transitions are called production identity assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate contact diversity, quorum, channel correlation, code reuse, coercion, notification, invalidation, live-service, and assurance fields; unsafe transitions must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject recovery, invalidate synthetic material, restore the last coherent fixture, notify only within the fixture, and require real standards-conformant services, security and privacy review, and trust governance for production.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior identity phases tested rotation, revocation, resolution, status, and downgrade; none modeled recovery-contact diversity, coercion, replay, and mandatory post-recovery notification together.

proposals.title: Procedural accommodation, language support, and representation-mandate authority gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR contestability, disability accommodations, language support, representation mandates, conflicts, revocation, affected-party participation, Māori wording and authority, and competent legal authority
proposals.hypothesis: A refusal-first schema can expose missing accommodation, support, representation mandate, conflict, or authority while explicitly refusing to manufacture legal, cultural, affected-party, disability, or Māori legitimacy.
proposals.null_or_failure: A technical artifact appoints a representative, treats language availability as informed acceptance, substitutes generic accessibility for individual accommodation, defines Māori authority, or interprets enacted law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate accommodation need, language, mandate scope, conflict, revocation, affected-party presence, Māori authority, cultural ratification, and legal competence; technical substitution must be refused.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the synthetic process, retain the unmet need, and defer to authorized affected parties, qualified support providers, Māori authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases preserved standing, remedies, appeals, jurisdiction, Māori wording, and collective authority; none tested accommodation and language support against an explicit representation-mandate lifecycle.

proposals.title: Private-source taint propagation and derived-artifact redaction quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: Private-field classification, transformations, derived values, aggregation, rendering, logs, route data, credentials, local paths, redaction, and public artifact release
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic taint-flow fixture can require private classifications to propagate through transforms and quarantine public outputs when provenance or redaction evidence is incomplete.
proposals.null_or_failure: Derived values lose taint without a rule, aggregation is assumed anonymous, rendered text bypasses classification, route or credential material reaches public output, or a zero-hit regex is called exhaustive privacy or security.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate source classification, transform lineage, aggregation, render sink, redaction receipt, route material, and assurance claim; unproven declassification must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the artifact, retain the failing flow, restore the last fully classified graph, and require human privacy and security review for any real release.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior privacy work scanned artifacts and modeled purpose or correlation; none propagated private-source taint through derived transformations to public render sinks.

proposals.title: Reflow, zoom, forced-colors, and print-preservation accessibility contract
proposals.mission_surface: Static report reflow, text resize, zoom, forced colors, focus, landmarks, page breaks, print visibility, automated structure, manual evaluation, and affected-user reservations
proposals.hypothesis: A static-report contract and synthetic mutation suite can detect common reflow, zoom, forced-color, and print-loss defects while preserving qualified manual and affected-user evaluation as open.
proposals.null_or_failure: Content clips at zoom, horizontal scrolling is forced for text, system colors are defeated, focus disappears, print removes boundaries, or automated checks are called complete accessibility conformance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate viewport, text scale, overflow, system colors, focus, print rules, landmark structure, and conformance claims; structural defects and overclaims must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last accessible static structure, retain the failing vector, and reserve complete conformance for qualified manual assessment and affected-user participation.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The earlier accessibility evidence map reserved manual evaluation but did not test reflow, zoom, forced-colors, and print preservation as one render contract.

proposals.title: Fluctuation-theorem domain and entropy-production analogy non-substitution barrier
proposals.mission_surface: Thermo-psyche analogy domains, forward and reverse path ensembles, microscopic reversibility, work, free-energy difference, entropy production, units, interventions, and category claims
proposals.hypothesis: A typed fixture can require fluctuation-theorem premises and reject substitution of psychological scores, software events, or information labels for physical work or entropy production.
proposals.null_or_failure: Forward and reverse ensembles are unmatched, microscopic reversibility is absent, units do not close, a score is relabeled as work or entropy production, or a structural pass is called a law of psyche.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate ensemble pairing, reversibility, work sign, temperature, units, free-energy term, score relabeling, and law claims; invalid analogies must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last typed physical fixture, retain the category error, and require actual physical measurements and scientific review for any thermodynamic claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases separated entropy categories, open systems, path dependence, and Landauer bounds; none tested forward/reverse path-probability premises of fluctuation theorems.

proposals.title: Multi-site THOS transportability and center-by-treatment heterogeneity real-arm gap
proposals.mission_surface: THOS site definitions, center-by-treatment interactions, recruitment mix, intervention delivery, measurement invariance, matched budgets, transport target, real arms, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered synthetic site matrix can expose underidentified transportability and center-by-treatment heterogeneity obligations without substituting fixtures for multi-site participant evidence.
proposals.null_or_failure: Sites are pooled without a rule, center-by-treatment interaction is ignored, recruitment or delivery differs silently, budgets are unmatched, the target population is undefined, or zero real sites are called transportability evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate site balance, recruitment, delivery, measurement invariance, interaction, target population, arm count, budget, and transport claims; unsupported pooling must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep transportability open, retain the synthetic failure, and require preregistered blind matched-budget real arms across authorized sites plus independent review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Covariate support and instrument invariance were tested separately; no prior THOS proposal modeled site-by-treatment heterogeneity, delivery variation, and a named transport target.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor/EFT research-model family. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms and independent review. Freed ID production and CBR or Māori authority remain gated to exact real-world evidence and competent authorities.
claim_boundary: No empirical confirmation, detected force, unique prediction, Theory of Everything, proof/canon, THOS superiority, production identity assurance, legal interpretation, enacted law, cultural ratification, Māori authority, deployment, exhaustive security, complete accessibility, AGI/ASI, consciousness, personhood, or independent reproduction is preregistered as established.
